newsitem.title: THAILAND: Ayudhya CMG to issue 35 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Ayudhya CMG to issue 35 mln new shares.

text.p: Thailand's Ayudhya CMG Life Assurance Plc said on Wednesday that it will issue 35 million new shares instead of the 80 million shares planned earlier due to the sluggish economy.

The company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the new shares would be issued to existing shareholders at a ratio of five new shares for every two shares held at 20 baht ($0.65) per share.
Ayudhya CMG in late June said it would issue 80 million new shares in an attempt to raise its registered capital to 1.01 billion baht from 210 million.
A spokeswoman of the company said Ayudhya will issue the remaining shares at a later date.
Ayudhya CMG was trading at 19 baht, down two baht, per share at 0855 GMT.
